name: dsh-client-ui-quote
description: Select text in the DSH transcript, a file preview or the terminal to quote it into the composer or into a side thread's composer, Kimi-Code style (comment / add to conversation / side chat), with Alt+Q/C/B, a jump back to the quoted source, a searchable quote list page that exports as Markdown, and one-click back-flow of a side thread's conclusion into the main composer.
author: BangBang-03

scripts.test: node test/check.mjs && node test/capsule.mjs && node test/panel.mjs
